name: @deepseek-ai/zdsh-factory-bundle
description: Factory preinstall artifact bundle: pins the git-URL + commit for every zDSH factory-seeded plugin so `pnpm install` lands each artifact under this package's node_modules closure (B4 case, DESIGN-intake-tech.md §1.1). The governance SeedPreinstaller never moves artifacts; it installs them in place via `install({ source: 'local:<...>/node_modules/<pkg>' })`. Batch 2 current set = webstack-verticals (factory-off pilot) + omnivision (boot-enabled) + webstack-bridge (boot-enabled webstack data-plane link). TC-B3-MM1b adds the two harness-honest rows: dsh-filehub + dsh-plugin-center (both installed-at-boot-off until the R-A harness flips their posture). TC-B3-MM2 adds the sixth row, dsh-autopilot — a product-design-off plugin (ADJ-3: the whole engine ships disabled by default, unlike the two harness-honest rows), pinned installed-at-boot-off.
